about.heading: Visalia’s best choice for convenient, safe, and affordable self storage
paragraphs: Welcome to Mid Valley Storage, Visalia’s best choice for convenient, safe, and affordable self storage. We pride ourselves with our friendly and professional customer service, state of the art security, and convenient locations.

We aim to become Visalia area’s premier and feature rich self storage facility. Whether you’re looking for a place to store your boat or RV after a camping or lake trip or looking to organize items from around the home or office, Mid Valley Storage does it all. Attentive detail without compromise can be seen throughout the facility from the moment the gate keypad recognizes your name and unit number, to the sophisticated temperature controlled units, well lit and video monitored RV and boat parking, and complete moving supply center in the office. Features aside, Mid Valley Storage has only one focus: the complete 110% satisfaction of its customers.

photo.alt: Mid Valley Storage office lobby with the service counter, a wall of security camera screens and moving supplies

items.title: Conventional Storage
items.text: Exterior drive-up units, interior drive-up units, small units, big, units – Mid Valley Storage has them all! With sizes from 5×5 to 20×50, we’ve got the perfect space just for you! It’s the perfect spot to store you extra items and get your garage back. Call us today and our professional staff can help you find the perfect size just for you.

photo.alt: Large drive-up storage buildings at dusk with pickup trucks parked in the wide yard

items.title: Temperature Controlled Storage
items.text: Scorching hot summers and cold foggy winters are no problem for our interior temperature controlled units. Cool air conditioning in the summer and warm heat in the winter – all in a interior dust free environment. Perfect for electronics, music equipment, antiques, documents, and so much more!

photo.alt: Long indoor hallway of white temperature controlled storage unit doors

items.title: RV/Boat/Auto Parking
items.text: With three National Parks nearby, numerous lakes, and the beach a few hours away – we know how great it is to hit the road in your RV, boat, or trailer. We have indoor, privately enclosed units with oversized doors perfect for your toys! All oversized units have the option of adding power and lights, perfect for keeping your battery charged before your next trip!

about.heading: About Mid Valley Storage

heroPhoto.alt: Large drive-up storage buildings at dusk with pickup trucks parked in the wide yard

story: Mid Valley Storage has deep roots in the beautiful Central Valley. Starting in 2004, it’s parent company began operating a property management company for residential real estate. Just a few years later as the company grew, they began their first ground-up construction project building a self storage and retail complex in East Visalia in 2009. Thousands of happy customers later, an expansion was made to Tulare with the extensive remodel of another self storage facility, Rapid Self Storage. In the following years, the property management component of the company grew to include additional residential and commercial rentals. Beginning in late 2018, a new site was chosen for another self-storage facility in Central Visalia and construction began. It’s newest site on Santa Fe features individual RV storage and drive-up self-storage. Today, Mid Valley Storage has all types of storage to fit your needs. Temperature controlled storage, drive-up self storage, indoor RV/boat storage, and a full moving center and free moving truck to make your storage experience as easy as possible.

items.title: Temperature Controlled Storage
items.text: Did you know the inside of regular storage units in the peak of summer can reach over 120 degrees? Self Storage units act like miniature ovens and are often much warmer then the outside air. At Mid Valley Storage, we have perfected inside temperature controlled storage. It’s comfortably air conditioned in the summer and heated in the winter. And, even better, it’s in a interior dust free environment – perfect for your precious belongings. Electronics, wood furniture, paper files, instruments, and antiques are perfect items for temperature controlled storage.

photo.alt: Long indoor hallway of white temperature controlled storage unit doors

items.title: Individual Enclosed RV Storage
items.text: Mid Valley Storage has some of the largest storage units around! We feature units up to 20’x50′ many with oversized doors up to 12’x14′. All oversize units have the option of interior lights and 20AMP power – perfect to keep your batteries charged! These large units were strategically placed to give plenty of room to drive into and out without tight turns. Each unit is has fire sprinklers and ceiling insulation for peace of mind and comfort. Call us today to learn more!

photo.alt: Motorhome parked inside an enclosed RV storage unit

items.title: Individual Keycode Access
items.text: We know moving can be exhausting but we’re here to help and make it as easy and secure as possible. At Mid Valley Storage we offer private, secure, and individual keycode access specific to your unit. We constantly review gate records against live security footage to ensure safe and secure access.

photo.alt: Driver reaching out of a car window to enter a code on the gate keypad

items.title: Outside Storage
items.text: In addition to our private enclosed RV and boat storage, we also offer outside parking. Our parking stalls are on DG (decomposed granite) to reduce dust and feature 24/7 security recording and great lighting to help with night visits.

photo.alt: Fifth-wheel travel trailer parked in an outdoor parking stall

items.title: Friendly Staff
items.text: Our friendly and professional staff is on-site and ready to help you six days a week. We like to call ourselves professional Tetris players and we can assist in choosing the perfect sized storage unit that fits your needs. Call us today, we can’t wait to hear from you!

photo.alt: Two Mid Valley Storage staff members holding branded moving boxes in the moving supply center

items.title: Easy accessibility
items.text: Moving is tough, storage shouldn’t be. Our drive aisles are some of the largest around making your move as simple as possible. We can handle the biggest moving trucks on the road and can even assist with the coordination national moving companies. Most facilities have 20′ wide drive aisles while Mid Valley has between 25-45′ wide drive aisles. Plenty of room to unload, pack, and maneuver those big moving trucks!

photo.alt: Wide paved drive aisle between tall storage buildings, lit at dusk

items.title: Convenient Access
items.text: We know your busy and it can be hard to get to your storage unit during the work day so we offer computerized gate access 365 days a year. For the early birds, our gate hours open at 6AM and for the night owls, are gates are open until 8PM. We can even offer extended gate hours for business customers or special events. Call us today for more information. We also offer convenient online payments, auto-payments, and no long term contracts.

photo.alt: Wide indoor aisle between rows of white roll-up storage doors

items.title: Security
items.text: Mid Valley Storage takes its security very seriously. We feature the highest resolution and most modern security cameras that monitor and protect our facilities, customers, and staff. We issue unique gate codes to each tenant that log the entry and exit of all gate activity. Our Noble location features an on-site resident for extra peace of mind. We know your items are important and they’re important to us too.
